name: Escalator Detail
summary: Lightweight static 3.6m-rise escalator with 18 independent steps and a blank signage post.
description: Original compact escalator module with ribbed separate steps, rounded-return handrails, segmented glass balustrades, two toothed comb plates and a blank signpost. Nominal 1m tread width, 6m footprint length and 3.6m deck rise. Static visual geometry for the GJH Virtual Mall.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and three shared materials; no external models, textures, fonts or images. No random inputs.

interface.step_pivot: Tread centre of each independent rigid step; glTF positions are measured in reports/assets.json
interface.front: Lower entry at +Z; upper landing at -Z
interface.runtime: Static rest pose only. Future animation must author hidden return steps and landing transitions. No animation, passenger transport, collider or interaction logic is included.

accuracy_notes: Dimensions and statistics are measured from the delivered GLB. Approximate 1m width refers to the clear tread; the outside casing measures 1.32m. The 6m run includes two short landings; incline is approximately 35.2 degrees. Blue-green glass uses closed alpha-blended geometry with backface culling and no transmission pass. Source parts may intersect at assembled joints. This static visual module has no hidden circulation mechanism, collider, passenger logic or engineering certification. Full mall integration, aggregate 200 draw-call budget, physical mobile devices and WebKit are not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and three shared materials; no external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
